title: Possible resumption/continuation of the Unipoli Route 32 blockade campaign
notes: October reports say Unipoli lifted the 16 Oct blockade after a provisional MOPT agreement and scheduled a follow-up meeting for 14–20 Nov. November reporting describes Route 32 protests over several days and an action on 20 Nov. Whether a public protest resumed, was a new event, or is commentary is unresolved. No separate November event is entered because onset is unknown and month-start ownership cannot be assigned. October S014's body-read provenance is incomplete.
open_questions: Did an actual public protest occur in November, and on what date(s)?
Did at least 50 people gather simultaneously?
Was this continuation after a pause or a distinct episode?
What were the exact locations and event-specific state response?
